title: 第59章 你好，亚洲
content_zh:
第59章 你好，亚洲-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

上一章

存书签

下一章

在2002年之前，亚洲一直没有国际性音乐颁奖典礼。

漂亮国有格莱美，欧洲有EMA，我们亚洲也要有自己的洲际音乐奖

于是，MTV亚洲大奖应运而生。

该奖项，旨在表彰亚洲及国际音乐人的卓越成就，涵盖流行、摇滚、电子等多元音乐风格。

今年是第6届，也是最后一届。

魏沐正好赶上了巅峰尾巴。

“老魏。这是我第一次去马莱西亚。你对那里了解吗？”

“不怎么了解。”

首都国际机场，VIP候机室。

魏沐和李雨春在经纪人的陪同下，等候前往国外的班机。

不管是上辈子还是这辈子，魏老板对马莱西亚都不怎么了解。

他对马莱西亚唯一的记忆点就是胡婧，这位高小琴的饰演者嫁了个马莱西亚的拿督....

后世不少营销号吧啦吧啦乱吹，把拿督吹到天上去。

搞得胡婧本人出来辟谣。

其实呢，这玩意就是个荣誉称号，没什么用，跟皇室没有一点关系。

飞机从京城起飞，经过6个小时，最后来到目的地。

从机场大厅出来，坐上公司安排的车来到下榻酒店。

在酒店，遇到了不少熟悉面孔。

古巨机、孙艳资以及时间管理大师罗智祥。

恰好，这三位分别是香江新加坡以及湾湾的最受欢迎歌手。

说白了，人家就是过来领奖的。

那些没获奖的候选者都没来。

上辈子魏沐考古看过一期《今夜不设防》，由黄霑倪匡主持的深夜综艺节目。

张国容便在上面讲过，任何颁奖典礼，是任何，在颁奖之前，候选人一定是知道结果。

明明知道结果还要来，这个时候就要考验候选者的演技。

真正的演技派不是获奖的时候，而是没有获奖的那一刻该怎么表现。

有些人知道自己没被选上，干脆没来。

弯弯原来的大热候选者蔡毅林、假唱天以及S.H.E都没来。

还有香江，刘德化陈艺讯也没来。

作为内地唯二获奖的本土歌手，魏沐和李雨春一露面，就呼啦啦围上来一堆记者，把他们二人分开。

“魏沐，《偏爱》登顶中歌榜和MTV榜，心情怎么样？”

“魏沐，如何评价《体面》专辑中六首歌全部排在各大榜单前十名？”

“魏沐，有人曝光你和MV女主角糖嫣因戏生情。这是真的吗？”

Chapter 59 Hello, Asia - "China Entertainment 2008: Starting from a Happy Breakup"

Before 2002, there had been no international music awards ceremony in Asia.

The beautiful country has the Grammy, Europe has the EMA, and we in Asia also need to have our own Intercontinental Music Awards.

Thus, the MTV Asia Awards came into being.

This award aims to recognize the outstanding achievements of Asian and international musicians, covering pop, rock, electronic and other diverse music styles.

This year is the 6th and last one.

Wei Mu just caught up with the peak.

"Old Wei. This is my first time to Malecia. Do you know anything about it?"

"I don't know much about it."

Capital International Airport, VIP waiting room.

Accompanied by their agent, Wei Mu and Li Yuchun were waiting for their flight abroad.

Regardless of whether it was in the previous life or this life, Boss Wei didn't know much about Malecia.

His only memory of Malecia is Hu Jing, the actress who played Gao Xiaoqin, who was married to a Malecia Datuk...

In later generations, many marketing trumpets were blown, blowing Datuk to the sky.

Hu Jing herself came out to refute the rumors.

In fact, this thing is just an honorary title, it is useless and has nothing to do with the royal family.

The plane took off from Beijing and finally arrived at its destination after 6 hours.

Come out of the airport lobby and take the car arranged by the company to your hotel.

At the hotel, I met many familiar faces.

Gu Juji, Sun Yanzi and time management guru Luo Zhixiang.

Coincidentally, these three are the most popular singers in Hong Kong, Singapore and Wanwan respectively.

To put it bluntly, they just came here to receive the award.

None of the candidates who did not win the prize came.

In his previous life, Wei Mu watched an episode of "Undefended Tonight", a late-night variety show hosted by Huang Zhanni Kuang.

Zhang Guorong said above that in any award ceremony, the candidates must know the results before awarding the award.

Obviously knowing that the results are still coming, the candidate's acting skills will be tested at this time.

The real talent of acting is not when you win an award, but how you behave when you don’t win.

Some people knew they were not selected and simply did not come.

Wanwan’s original popular candidates Cai Yilin, lip-synching Tian and S.H.E didn’t come.

There is also Xiangjiang, Liu Dehua and Chen Yixin are not here either.

As the only award-winning local singers in the Mainland, as soon as Wei Mu and Li Yuchun showed up, a bunch of reporters gathered around them and separated them.

"Wei Mu, "Preferred" topped the Chinese singing charts and MTV charts. How do you feel?"

"Wei Mu, how do you evaluate that all six songs in the "Decent" album are ranked in the top ten of major charts?"

"Wei Mu, someone exposed that you and the MV heroine Tang Yan fell in love because of drama. Is this true?"
